notes:
Taps that were being ignored, and tags you can actually browse.

**Taps on the lower part of a tab, or the page slider, were being swallowed.** The pen area of the screen is told to keep clear of the toolbar so your taps reach the buttons — but that boundary was worked out once and never revisited, so when the tab strip appeared and made the toolbar taller, the strip along the bottom stayed off limits. Anything you tapped down there went nowhere. It is now kept up to date whenever the toolbar changes size.

**The whole tab is now tappable.** Only the title text itself responded before, so a piece with a short name gave you a very small target, and the edges of the tab did nothing at all.

**Tapping "Tags" now shows a tidy list of tag names.** Groups you had opened previously stayed open, so there was no quick way back to a plain index. Tapping Tags now collapses everything — and tapping it again while already in Tags is a quick way to close them all.

**In Tags, the search box now finds tag names too.** Type "Advent" and you get the Advent group with its pieces, rather than only pieces with "Advent" in the title.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
